title: Coefficient comparison from finite constant projection
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings and phi:A to B a ring map. Let c compactify f:X to Y [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For T=X,Y let L_T be any left adjoint of exact derived scalar restriction. If the ambient A compact-support functor has a right adjoint, the inverse scalar-adjunction mate of the normalized support restriction square [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] is invertible on every unbounded object.

source.place: Coefficient comparison proof; Stacks Tags 06YY, 07A6 and 0GL6.

proof.text: Transport the compact-support adjunction through the realization equivalences to fixed coefficients, obtaining a left adjoint and preservation of all small coproducts. Apply the finite constant projection theorem with the restricted target ring as a source module. Its arrow identification gives invertibility after exact restriction and realization. Derived realization reflects isomorphisms. Derived scalar restriction reflects them because its homology functor is underived conservative restriction. Hence the original scalar mate is invertible.

proof_origin: C3: canonical projection formula and normalized scalar comparison.

theorem supportCoefficient_isIso_of_projection
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (LX : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory X B)
    (LY : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory Y B)
    (aX : LX ⊣ (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars X φ).mapDerivedCategory)
    (aY : LY ⊣ (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategory)
    {G : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A ⥤ proEtaleDerivedCategory X A}
    (a : sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate A c ⊣ G)
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    IsIso ((((mateEquiv aX aY).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (sfCompactSupportRestriction c φ).hom)).natTrans).app K)
